dimensions.note: api_key (and private_key for the ssh transport) is sensitive-marked and travels only in the X-API-Key header: locally via fetch, remotely inside a curl config streamed on stdin to `curl -q --config -` through the canonical _lib/ssh.ts (proto =http,https), so no secret byte touches remote disk. State and logs hold node, normalized api_url, ids, labels and counts, never the key. Live on 2ef94b9 cell 10: ps sampled every 50 ms on the control host and both nodes found 0 hits for the keys, their substrings or SHA-256 (positive control hit), and the only remote command was exactly `curl -q --config -`; cell 11: no cache directory, *.curlrc or upload temp file appeared on either host and a content scan of every new file found no key. Residual LOW: remote curl stderr enters errors as its last line capped at 200 characters; curl does not echo header values there.
Each method logs once with structured placeholders (node, device, folder, changed); no key, header, argv or response body in log fields.

Non-2xx responses raise a typed SyncthingError carrying the status; 401/403 now say the API key was rejected (merge-prep message fix for the live cell 7 note). sync records unreachable only for a connect, DNS or timeout failure (ssh connect failure, curl exit 6/7/28, a classified fetch TypeError) and rethrows auth, TLS, 3xx, 5xx and code errors (live cells 7, 8, 9). Every OpenSSH exit 255 is a typed SshError; a host-key mismatch refuses to connect.

80 unit tests (model, REST client and the vendored transport) with injected fetch and ssh runners and a plain-object method context; a recording-runner test asserts the config is on stdin, the key on no argv and that no mktemp/curlrc/umask/cache-dir/rm command is issued; review added a hostile-label curl-config test against real curl. Live end to end on two VPS nodes with Syncthing 1.27.2: 12/12 cells on 2ef94b9 (the 10 cells of 2026.10.17.1 repeated, plus no remote file written and a hostile folder label stored verbatim with every request to the loopback).

ensure_device and ensure_folder read first, create with PUT and update with PATCH only on a declared-field difference, so unmanaged fields survive (live cell 4); repeats report changed false. remove_* is a no-op when absent, treats a DELETE 404 as already gone and confirms absence by re-reading. Requests are bounded by timeout_s (AbortSignal.timeout; curl max-time and connect-timeout); a remote step carries timeoutMs = max-time + 5 s so curl stops first. Residual LOW: after a local timeout the remote curl keeps running until its own max-time stops it.

Syncthing REST /rest/system/status and /rest/config/{devices,folders}, live-verified against syncthing 1.27.2. The ssh transport needs curl on the node; the API is reached at a loopback or HTTPS origin only.

No remote file at all in 2026.10.17.2: the curl config is stdin only, so the 0700 cache directory, upload, sweep and trap cleanup are gone and a dropped session cannot strand the key (live cell 11: 0 files). Local temp files of the vendored transport are removed in finally; remote output is capped by the transport.

Manifest @randybias/syncthing-peer 2026.10.17.2 (model version literal matches), two-sentence description, Apache-2.0, additionalFiles README.md and LICENSE.txt. Fixtures use RFC 5737 addresses and synthetic keys; leak scan, gitleaks, fixture guard and the naming check (visibility public, audience general, name judged keep) pass. Residual LOW: no docs/specs spec for this extension.

Global arguments are an empty strictObject; method arguments are strict. api_url must be an origin (no userinfo, path, query or fragment; plain HTTP only on loopback) and is normalized before keying; device ids, folder ids (no . or ..), device addresses (dynamic or tcp/quic/relay host:port) and names/labels (printable-ASCII allowlist) carry grammars; api_key 8-128, timeout_s 1-600. Live cell 6: folder_id .. refused with no connection made.
node, device and folder resources: lifetime infinite, garbageCollection 10.
get/sync (read), ensure_device/ensure_folder (create/update) and remove_device/remove_folder (delete) cover devices and folders on one node.
api_url, ids, addresses, labels and host-key policy are validated before any request or ssh spawn (live cell 6: folder_id .. refused with no connection made).

syncthing-<32 hex>: SHA-256 over node label and normalized api_url, truncated to 128 bits; device and folder records append a length-prefixed id, so equivalent URLs share one record and ids cannot collide.
Methods read only this model's own records; every node, device and folder arrives as method arguments, so one definition serves any node.

2026.10.17.1 is published (beta). 2026.10.17.2 re-vendors _lib/ssh.ts as the canonical blob 8f132c4329c9e64bed686731cd5a0e02980194ea (ssh-host 2026.10.17.3) and changes only the remote delivery of the curl config; inputs and the REST contract are unchanged, so the upgrades[] entry is a no-op (upgradeAttributes returns the old attributes).
